summary: Wise Group plc filed a Form 6-K disclosing its ongoing share buyback program. From 17-21 August 2026, it repurchased 572,875 Class A ordinary shares on Nasdaq and other US venues plus 768,520 on London venues, with prices ranging from GBP 9.22 to 9.67 (XLON vol. weighted) and USD 12.55 to 13.02 on Nasdaq. The buyback, announced July 21, 2026, targets repurchases up to £405 million (~$540 million). Shares bought are held in treasury. Goldman Sachs International executes trades in compliance with UK MAR and FCA Listing Rule 14.3.17(2). Watch for continued repurchase cadence and program completion updates.
